key_insight: PeriaTrace links tooth-level findings in periapical radiographs to image evidence and generates technical reports alongside patient-friendly explanations.
clinical_relevance: The framework could speed clinician-reviewed reporting and make dental imaging findings easier for patients to understand.
method: Localize teeth, assign FDI tooth identifiers, and identify tooth-level findings.
Generate reports with visual grounding that links findings to image evidence.
Produce plain-language explanations and care recommendations for clinical review.
evidence_signal: Developed and evaluated using 12,877 radiographs across an internal dataset and two external cohorts, PeriaTrace generated reports in 4.41 seconds per image; senior endodontists judged 91.16% and 84.52% of external-cohort reports retainable or revisable without complete rewriting.
watch_item: Report acceptability and patient preference do not establish diagnostic safety or improved outcomes; clinical oversight remains necessary.
paper_title: PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs
